ideas.topic: The Hidden Secret of the Pyramids' Color
ideas.hook: You think the pyramids were always brown? They were actually blinding white mirrors.
ideas.why: It uses the 'common misconception' hook format that drove the viral dress video, appealing to viewers' desire to correct their historical understanding.

ideas.hook: You’ve seen cat memes, but you haven't seen an Ancient Egyptian priest treat one like a god.
ideas.why: It bridges the high-performing 'cat content' trend with historical education, satisfying the audience's interest in both entertainment and culture.

ideas.hook: Forget modern luxury; the most effective skincare in history was invented 4,000 years ago.
ideas.why: It utilizes the 'humanizing history' angle, focusing on daily life and beauty rituals, which performs exceptionally well by connecting ancient artifacts to relatable modern habits.
